content.description: New durable memory content to propose. Keep it concise and factual; do not store transient task progress, command output, logs, or one-off errors. The backend validates, dedupes, saves, and embeds accepted proposals.

scope.description: Use thread for facts or preferences that apply only inside the current platform thread. Use channel for context shared by the current Slack/Discord/etc channel or group. Use project for project-shared facts. Use user for preferences or facts about the current user. Use global only for shared rules or facts that should apply across users.

kind.description: Short category such as fact, preference, instruction, decision, constraint, identity, workflow, reference, or feedback.

tags.description: Optional short lowercase tags for filtering and review. Prefer preference, decision, project, identity, workflow, or constraint when applicable.

confidence.description: Confidence that this memory should be reused later. Defaults to 1.

pinned.description: Whether this memory should be preferred in fallback context. Pin only high-value long-term memory.

reason.description: Why this should be remembered and reused later.
